in_marathi.name: Parbhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parbhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parbhu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Par’, meaning ‘supreme’, and ‘Bhu’, meaning ‘earth’ or ‘Lord’. This name signifies a master or ruler over the earth and is often given to boys in Hindu tradition who are believed to have strong leadership qualities.
